build_cascade_mask_rcnn: build a cascade mask r-cnn model with resnet101 backbone and seesaw loss for lvis v1 instance segmentation
create_seesaw_loss_config: create a seesaw loss configuration with p=0.8 and q=2.0 for imbalanced lvis v1 classification
run_train_pipeline: run a training pipeline with random choice resize, random flip, and pack detection inputs for lvis dataset
test_lvis_evaluation: test model evaluation using lvis metric with bbox and segmentation scores on lvis v1 validation set
configure_roi_heads: configure three-stage shared 2fc bbox heads with delta xywh bbox coder and normed linear classifier for cascade rcnn
